_readme: Editorial layer over the Printful catalog. Keys in byName must match the Printful product name exactly. Fields: description, category (apparel|accessories|home), artist, tags, order (lower = earlier; unset = 500, then newest first), new (badge), hidden, slug. typeDescriptions are regex → fallback copy used when a product has no description. hiddenIds: Printful product IDs to hide from the site (value is just a note).

typeDescriptions.hoodie:
Unisex premium pullover hoodie. Heavyweight cotton-blend fleece, double-lined hood, front pouch pocket. Printed to order.
